```plato

//==
// # Composite and derived forms
//
// Polynomial constructions assembled out of the forms declared in
// the sections above: a piecewise polynomial over ascending breakpoints, a
// Pade approximant pairing a numerator with a normalized denominator, and a
// Sturm chain for counting real roots by sign changes.

// A piecewise polynomial (spline in polynomial form;
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Piecewise). Breakpoints ascend and number one
// more than Pieces; piece i applies on the half-open span from Breakpoints[i]
// to Breakpoints[i+1] and is evaluated in the local variable x - Breakpoints[i].
type PiecewisePolynomial
    implements IValue
{
    Breakpoints: Array<Number>;
    Pieces: Array<Polynomial>;
}
```
